scope: comments under any post in a public, current space, except member introductions and events
excluded_private_context_hints: 私信、私聊、群聊、短信或 DM
电话、手机号、邮箱或住址
excluded_sensitive_context: health, bereavement, minor status, immigration or layoff context
personal income, compensation or financial context
internal community operations or sponsorship context

include.advice: 给提问者或读者的具体建议
include.explanation: 解释原因、机制、概念或取舍
include.experience: 他本人的经历、做法或观察
include.information: 有用的事实或资源，不是事务通知

exclude.social: 欢迎、感谢、夸奖、祝贺，没有说出看法或理由
exclude.admin: 搬帖、排期、链接指路，以及课程、会员、报名、付款、退款等事务
exclude.context: 不看原帖和其他成员的话就读不懂
exclude.private: 谈到某位成员的健康、家庭、感情、收入数字、移民身份、被裁或与人冲突等敏感私事

privacy_redactions: all inline links and bare domains (the canonical Circle comment link is retained)
rationale: Every comment Yuzheng wrote under a post in a public space is considered. Rules first remove contact details and private channels, introduction and hiring threads, other people's private circumstances, leading third-party quotations and comments under the minimum length; a pinned review then keeps each comment that states a view, advice, an explanation, his own experience or useful information, and leaves out small talk, administration, chat, replies that cannot be read without the thread, and anything about a member's private situation. Comments in members-only spaces are not included.
